title: Elliptic-fibration compactification of a maximally mutable complex Laurent polynomial whose Newton polygon is a T-polygon
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) article 095, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2024.095; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author identifies mutability conditions with sections of a line bundle on an iterated boundary blowup and resolves each tangential pencil basepoint by explicit local coordinates. Resolving the full mutable cycle yields a base-point-free complete pencil, from which connected elliptic fibres and the specified boundary fibre follow. The local resolution and global pencil construction are the substantive obligation beyond merely applying Bertini to an already constructed fibration.
author: Wendelin Lutz
